artifact.title: Observed analogue: highest-load day 2017-12-13 (Germany, OPSD/ENTSO-E)

cost_basis.provenance: PyPSA v1.4.0 scigrid-de example uses illustrative per-carrier marginal costs; the upstream scigrid-lopf-then-pf notebook says these are not accurate.
assumptions: Example costs are placeholders, not market prices or a verified currency basis.
Only runs on this same example cost basis are monetarily comparable.
VOLL is a scenario penalty in illustrative cost units/MWh, not an economic outage-damage estimate.

penalties.description: Scenario VOLL interpreted in the dataset money unit; not an economic estimate.

assumptions: DC linearised power flow (LOPF) — no reactive power, voltage magnitudes or losses
Kirchhoff's voltage law imposed on a cycle basis with series reactances (x_pu_eff); branch active-power flow limited to s_nom x s_max_pu
Perfect foresight: all snapshots of the horizon are optimised jointly in one LP
Costs are short-run marginal costs from the dataset; nodal prices are LP duals of the nodal balance constraints
Modeled results for scenario analysis — not a validated blackout predictor or operational forecast
All monetary coefficients and legacy *_eur fields use illustrative cost units; no currency conversion is performed.
Example costs are placeholders, not market prices or a verified currency basis.
Only runs on this same example cost basis are monetarily comparable.
VOLL is a scenario penalty in illustrative cost units/MWh, not an economic outage-damage estimate.

Load shedding modelled as one dispatchable generator per load bus (485 buses), marginal cost = VOLL 10000 illustrative cost units/MWh, bounded by the bus demand at every snapshot; VOLL is a penalty parameter, not an economic estimate

Demand input (CC BY 4.0): Day-ahead forecast of the total load per market time unit, Germany (Reg. (EU) 543/2013 Art. 6.1.b), ENTSO-E Transparency Platform (https://transparency.entsoe.eu/), obtained via Open Power System Data, Time series 2020-10-06 (https://doi.org/10.25832/time_series/2020-10-06), column DE_load_forecast_entsoe_transparency. Licensed under CC BY 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/) per the ENTSO-E list of data available for free re-use (2023-10-18), item #1. Changes made by GridStorm: the stress day's 24 hourly values are divided by the mean of the nearest 1 January (UTC), then by the scigrid-de network's normalized hourly load, and rounded to 4 decimals; only these ratios are published.

Stress-day selection: the date was chosen in OPSD actual load and wind/solar generation and capacity (ENTSO-E Reg. 543/2013 Art. 6.1.a and 16.1; OPSD calculations based on BNetzA and netztransparenz.de). Those series are not openly licensed; GridStorm stores no value or statistic derived from them except the date and the coarse daily renewable multipliers below (data/observed/opsd-de/manifest.json, source.column_reuse).

Time alignment: network snapshot h = UTC hour h of the stress day. Evidence (data/observed/opsd-de/derived-multipliers.json, alignment_evidence): the network's solar availability matches observed 1 January solar CF far better in UTC than shifted to local time; for load the evidence is weaker.

MODELED demand mapping, applied uniformly to every load: m_h = [F(d,h) / mean_h F(ref,h)] / [L_net(h) / mean_h L_net(h)], F = day-ahead load forecast, reference day ref = 2018-01-01 (the 1 January nearest to d, i.e. the analogue of the network's own 1 January profile). The scaled network load follows the forecast stress-day shape and its level relative to a 1 January; the actual load differs from the forecast by the forecast error. Multipliers rounded to 4 decimals; clipped to (0, 5] at hours [none].

MODELED renewable shortfall per carrier c (Wind Onshore, Wind Offshore, Solar), applied to every generator of c for the whole day: w_c = min(round(mean_h CF_obs,c / mean_h CF_net,c / 0.05) * 0.05, 1), CF_obs = national generation / national capacity, CF_net = capacity-weighted p_max_pu of the network's generators of c. The hourly shape stays the network's own 2011-01-01 shape; the observed hourly profile is deliberately not reproduced (not openly licensed). No event when w = 1. Wind Onshore w = 1.00 (ratio above 1, clipped); Wind Offshore w = 0.90; Solar w = 0.70.
Aggregate national profiles are applied uniformly to every bus/generator: the spatial pattern of load and of wind/solar availability remains the network's 2011-01-01 pattern; only levels change.

The network (2011 grid topology, 2014 renewable capacities, 2011 demand profile) differs from the observed year's system; installed capacities are NOT rescaled. This is an analogue stress test, not a reconstruction of the observed day.
warnings: Dataset carriers carry no CO2 intensities (all zero/missing): co2_emissions_t is null (data gap, not a zero-emission finding)
